mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_members (project_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{role}) ON CONFLICT (project_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = EXCLUDED.role
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.name AS name, u.email AS email, pm.role AS role, pm.created_at AS createdAt FROM project_members pm JOIN users u ON u.id = pm.user_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY pm.created_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_members WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT project_id FROM project_members WHERE user_id = #{userId}
